blocks.title: Secure Communication, Remote Access, and Control Selection comparison
Secure Communication, Remote Access, and Control Selection exam shortcuts
items: Remote user needs encrypted access → VPN
Create a protected logical connection over the internet.
Example: An employee securely connects from home.
Example: A browser connects to an internal portal over HTTPS.
Secure IP traffic between networks → IPsec
IPsec is common for site-to-site VPNs.
Example: Two offices connect through an IPsec tunnel.
Multiple branch links need centralized control → SD-WAN
SD-WAN manages WAN paths with software-defined policy.
Example: A branch uses broadband and MPLS under centralized control.
SASE combines WAN connectivity with cloud-delivered security.
Example: Remote users receive secure access and filtering through one service.
Question asks BEST control → MATCH CONTROL TO RISK
Choose the control that directly addresses the requirement.
Example: WAF for web attacks, VPN for encrypted remote access.
blocks.example: Focus on the exact requirement in the scenario before choosing the control.

questions.q: A remote employee needs an encrypted connection to internal enterprise resources over the internet. Which technology is most appropriate?
questions.explanation: A VPN creates an encrypted logical connection over an untrusted network.

questions.q: A browser must securely access an internal portal over HTTPS. Which protocol provides the protection?
questions.explanation: TLS secures application communications such as HTTPS.

questions.q: Two offices need an encrypted site-to-site connection at the IP layer. Which technology is most appropriate?
questions.explanation: IPsec secures IP traffic and is commonly used for site-to-site VPNs.

questions.q: A company wants centralized policy-based control over multiple WAN links connecting branch offices. Which technology best fits?
questions.explanation: SD-WAN provides software-defined management of WAN connectivity.

questions.q: A distributed workforce needs cloud-delivered networking and security services in one architecture. Which model best fits?
questions.explanation: SASE combines networking and cloud-delivered security services.

questions.q: A scenario asks for the BEST control to protect a web application from SQL injection. Which choice is most appropriate?
questions.explanation: Effective control selection means matching the control directly to the risk.
